summary: Attendo AB (publ) provides health and care services in Scandinavia and Finland. The company offers nursing homes for people with dementia or somatic care requirements; home care services, including care, meals, cleaning, laundry, evening and night, and home health care services; and homes for people of various ages with a range of disabilities or care needs. It also provides day care, respite care and companion, meal and staffing services, as well as short term accommodation; personalized residential care for people with neuropsychiatric and psychosocial disorders; and runs family homes, crisis and emergency homes, HVB homes, dependency care, schools, and various forms of supportive housing. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Danderyd, Sweden.
